status: candidate label protocol for pipeline pilot; no Student training
depth_definition: use native Sintel depth as axial Z only after official stereo consistency check
label_domain_meaning: pilot fitting and supervision domain borrowed from VDA evaluation; values outside are not declared incorrect GT
mapping: d_ref = a / Z + b; one ordinary least-squares fit per complete 25-frame clip to native normalized float VDA; require a>0
fit_support: all finite pixels strictly inside label_domain_m across 25 frames, equal pixel weights
input: RGB + original normalized float VDA; no GT fitting of input, no q8 used as Student input in this pilot
output_clipping: none; report target outside [0,1], do not hide affine extrapolation
validity: depth range/finite plus finite target only; NOT confidence in edges/transparency or full GT annotation quality
coordinate_grid: native 1024x436; no crop, padding, resizing or camera update
focus_K: not defined for geometry-only pairs; must freeze before CoC loss or bokeh rendering
perturbation: not generated; choose and freeze magnitudes from pilot_train residual statistics only
deployment: reference mapping is training/analysis label construction; no GT, alignment or reference mask available to deployed Student
evaluation_limit: pilot_dev uses its own GT only for reference construction; affine fit absorbs global scale/shift errors, not an independent metric-depth benchmark
geometry_scope: selective geometry correction, not automatic whole-subject sharpness
